$comment: The pinned substrate target. api-schema.json in this directory is the ONLY permitted source for substrate client codegen (OSADE.md §4.1). backend/ is reference reading for behaviour, never for API derivation.

identity.$comment: The substrate's version string is NOT a contract. Two builds both report 0.8.2 with different protocols and a 10-method gap (PRD-DELTA #1). The identity of a substrate target is the tuple (protocol, method set), and the version string is a label. Directory names are <version>-p<protocol> for that reason.

binary.$comment: Release assets for v0.8.2, hashed from what GitHub actually serves. NOT committed - ~91 MB of binaries do not belong in git. `node scripts/fetch-substrate-binaries.mjs` downloads and verifies against these. CONFIRMED 2026-09-11: the Windows binary inside the zip hashes to the value the schema was captured from, so the pinned schema comes from the genuine release build - while backend/ source is AHEAD of v0.8.2 (ADR 0002). Binary and source are pinned to different things, deliberately and now provably. `{project}` in asset names is filled by the fetch script; after verify the file is renamed to osade-runtime.

third_party.$comment: The Windows zip ships notices for ConPTY only, copied into third-party/. Rust crate attribution is NOT in the release - see RUST-CRATES.md, generated from the pinned Cargo.lock.

binary.verify_at_boot: A matching checksum is not the only gate. Run the boot drift check (OSADE.md 4.1.1) regardless: a different runtime may be on PATH.

license.$comment: The runtime is Apache-2.0. LICENSE is the file from the pinned tag, byte for byte, so attribution does not depend on the network or on backend/ still being present. There is NO NOTICE file upstream (NOTICE at the pinned tag of license.upstream_repository is 404), so Apache-2.0 section 4(d) has nothing to propagate - recorded here so nobody re-checks, and so nobody writes one.
license.source: LICENSE at tag v0.8.2 of license.upstream_repository

known_gaps.$comment: Methods present in backend/src/api/schema.rs but absent from this pinned schema. Calling any of these against this target returns invalid_request. See PRD-DELTA #1.
